exemplos.summary: Integration of the JT-60SA Actively Cooled Divertor
exemplos.content: Integration of the JT-60SA Actively Cooled Divertor

description:
The scope of this contract is divided into service and hardware. The service
encompasses tasks such as storage, assembly, welding, installation, and inspection of the
divertor components and diagnostic components. The hardware involves the production and/or
acquisition of Langmuir probes, Halo current (Rogowski) coils, Thermocouples, Gas injection
pipes, Electrical shunts, Diagnostic connectors, Divertor fasteners, Divertor alignment
components, Main water pipe caps.
title: Integration of the JT-60SA Actively Cooled Divertor

description:
TYPE OF NOTICE 
This call for expressions of interest for donation falls outside the scope of public procurement rules. The procedure will, however, comply with the general procurement principles of transparency, proportionality, equal treatment, non-discrimination and sound financial management. 
DESCRIPTION OF THE SUBJECT MATTER of the call for expressions of interest 
The aim of this call for expressions of interest is to compile a list of pre-selected candidates, according to the criteria set out in the call for expressions of interests, for the donation of ICT equipment no longer used by the EBA. A donation agreement will be signed with the selected candidate(s). See template in Annex 3 to the Call for expressions of interests. The equipment consists of 109 iPhones.  The iPhones are fully functional and have been wiped, i.e. they have been reset to factory settings. The iPhone model is the iPhone 8 Plus. They were all purchased in 2020. 
HOW TO SUBMIT AN EXPRESSION OF INTEREST 
The expressions of interest must be sent by email to tenders@eba.europa.eu. The call for expressions of interests notice and annexes are also available in https://www.eba.europa.eu/about-us/procurement, under "Documents". COMMENT SOUMETTRE UNE MANIFESTATION D'INTERET Les manifestations d'interet doivent être envoyées par courriel à tenders@eba.europa.eu. L'avis d'appel à manifestations d'interet et ses annexes sont aussi disponibles à https://www.eba.europa.eu/about-us/procurement, dans "Documents".

exemplos.summary: Aviation training services for the European Union Aviation Safety Agency - EASA
exemplos.content: Aviation training services for the European Union Aviation Safety Agency - EASA

description:
The aim of this call for tender is to maintain, update, and expand the expertise of the Agency’s staff across a wide range of aviation technical areas. To this end EASA intends to conclude multiple framework contracts for the provision of aviation training services.
In support of its core mandate to ensure the highest levels of aviation safety, the Agency seeks to procure high quality training services that support its operational and strategic objectives.
